service.description: One operation (list, get, store, test, consumers) of a gateway kind: paymentGateway (PaymentGatewayConfig with its type's options and its SystemMessageRemote), shippingGateway (ShippingGatewayConfig with its remote) or taxGateway (TaxGatewayConfig). The connection's address, user and secrets are the remote's, under the framework's rules (write-only secrets, the endpoint-change rule, a test with no credentials, no internal address for a connection that may not use the private network). Mantle's own validation: a gateway is started only as a registered provider type (Authorize.Net, PayTrace, Shippo), whose service names are the type's and are never entered (UNSUPPORTED_TYPE); on a production instance its address is one of its provider's (PROVIDER_ADDRESS); its usage agrees with the address and, for a shipping gateway, with its test mode (USAGE_MISMATCH); the type's options are typed. A payment gateway's detail adds the organizations it is permitted for, those the caller administers (organizationList), a count of the others and the organizations it may still be permitted for. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW to read and ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE to change or test.

Which internal organization may use a payment gateway (PaymentGatewayOrganization, the one service that writes it): permitted from fromDate (now for a new binding) until thruDate, enabled or not, at the revision read (expectedRevision as get#Connection's organizationList gives it, empty for a new binding). remove ends the binding now: it is never deleted, and one that payment methods or stores of the organization still name is ended from now on at the earliest (endedProspectively), so what they started keeps its gateway for reconciliation and the reason says who still names it. Enabling a binding that had ended starts a new period now. Refused, with the reason: a stale revision (STALE_REVISION), an end before the start (DATES_INVALID), a later start for a binding in use (IN_USE), removing what is not bound (NOT_BOUND). Accounting's payment methods and Commerce's checkout offer only the enabled, current bindings and change neither this nor a credential. The audit log keeps each change with its reason. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_MANAGE and an organization the caller administers.

Where Mantle's records use a remote system (a connection of the framework's remote kind): the payment and shipping gateways whose connection it is, and the store integration it binds, for a store of an organization the caller administers. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW.
The facilities that print a kind of document on a network printer (FacilityPrinter), named for the organizations the caller administers and counted for the others. Needs ADMIN_CONNECTION_VIEW.
